messages.content: Thanks a lot! Before I embark on this journey, it makes sense to ensure I won't be left stranded due to an empty tank. Just add to the tank fully.

messages.content: Thanks a lot! Before I embark on this journey, it makes sense to ensure I won't be left stranded due to an empty tank. Just add to the tank fully.

messages: ChatCompletionMessage(content=None, refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[ChatCompletionMessageFunctionToolCall(id='chatcmpl-tool-9aca4185d682e387', function=Function(arguments='{"fuelAmount": 50}', name='fillFuelTank'), type='function')], reasoning='The user wants to fill their tank completely.
